| Improved Compression (C_sem): Structured Simplification with Meaning Preservation |
| C_sem replaces scalar C with a semantic-aware operator to reduce density while minimizing loss of original meaning. |
| Key upgrades over v4.9 scalar C: |
| - Uses vector embeddings for states (e.g., via sentence transformers or simple word2vec). |
| - Applies dimension reduction (PCA or autoencoder-like truncation) but with pre/post checks. |
| - Lossless fallback: if semantic distance > threshold, skip compression or use partial. |
| - Structure: Sort components by info value (e.g., magnitude or relevance to I), truncate low-value, preserve high. |
| - Meaning metric: Cosine sim or KL on embedded pre/post states > 0.95 target. |
| Pseudocode Example: |
| def c_sem(state, invariant, ratio=0.5, cos_threshold=0.95): |
|   # Embed if not already (assume vector) |
|   # Sort by relevance to invariant (cos sim per dim) |
|   rel_scores = [np.dot(state[i:i+1], invariant) for i in range(len(state))] # Simplified |
|   sorted_idx = np.argsort(rel_scores)[::-1] |
|   target_dim = int(len(state) * ratio) |
|   compressed = state[sorted_idx[:target_dim]] |
|   # Check preservation |
|   cos_sim = np.dot(compressed / np.linalg.norm(compressed), state[:target_dim] / np.linalg.norm(state[:target_dim])) |
|   if cos_sim < cos_threshold: |
|     return state # Fallback to no loss |
|   return compressed |
|==============================================|

| Fixed point (mean): S* ≈ I ⊙ E / (1 - effective_C) # vectorized |

| Hard clip: ||Sₙ - I||₂ ≤ max_excursion (typ. 4–6 norms) |
| Resonance metric: V = cos_sim(Sₙ, I) → target > 0.95 (up from 0.90) |
| New: Semantic loss cap: post-C_sem KL(S', S) < 0.05 or prune step |
